name: Beleth
why: instance boss: the route ends at its entry NPC Teleport Cube (Naia Cube) (32376)

other.manual: Naia Lock 18491 (16409,244438,11620) must be below 10 % HP before "Push the button." (else the device casts Overflow); one party at a time; then 12 rooms (Ingenious Contraption "Flip the switch.", 5 min each) and the spore challenge until Epidos spawns
Tully's Workshop floors 6-8: the 7th floor Agent 32372 / Teleportation Cubic 32467 takes the party to the roof (21935,243923,11088); kill Darion 25603 there
attack the Naia Lock 18491 (16409,244438,11620) to below 10 % HP (do not kill it)

12 rooms (Ingenious Contraption 'Flip the switch.', party, 5 min each), then the spore challenge until Epidos spawns; kill Epidos -> the Naia Cube 32376 spawns at (-45482,246277,-14184) (the party stands at the cube when Epidos dies)

conditions.text: Naia Cube 32376 (spawned in Core Naia when Epidos dies, Epidos.java): only the command channel leader with at least BelethMinPlayers members (server config) while Beleth is alive teleports the channel (members within 3000) in. The way to the cube: Hellbound -> Deltuva -> Dorian -> Tully's Workshop floors -> roof (Darion) -> Tower of Naia (Naia Lock + Control Device) -> 12 rooms -> Epidos.

Warpgate 32314 (next to the Wastelands landing and at Heine) teleports into Hellbound only after Path to Hellbound (Q130) or Thats Bloody Hot (Q133) is completed (both start at level 78); everyone else is sent back to the Wastelands (Hellbound zone check every entry).

Deltuva 32313 (in front of a cave right after the Steel Citadel outer gate) "Let me into the Steel Citadel." -> (17934,283189,-9701) next to Dorian, only after quest 132 Matras' Curiosity is completed (32313-02.htm otherwise). GUIDE: lineage.pmfun.com Hellbound guide (stage 11: "search out the NPC Deltuva and teleport directly into Tully's Workshop").

Dorian 32373 "Get help." (party leader, all members within 300) -> 1st floor (-13400,272827,-15300). Floor Teleport Devices "Go upstairs.": 32753 -> (-12700,273340,-13600), 32754 -> (-13246,275740,-11936), 32755 -> (-12798,273458,-10496), 32756 -> (-13500,275912,-9032) (Tully's floor; Tully 25544 at -12557,273901,-9000). Tully's Gatekeepers 18445-18461 ("Attempt to operate the machine.") open their doors for 120 s.

Roof (21935,243923,11088, reached from Tully's Workshop 7th/8th floor via the Agent 32372 / Teleportation Cubic 32467 after Darion 25603) -> Control Device 18492 "Push the button." -> "Enter the Tower of Naia." -> (-47271,246098,-9120). GUIDE: lineage.pmfun.com Hellbound guide ("defeat Darion ... access Tower of Naia. Complete twelve rooms within five-minute limits").
